# Coverage

Furniture frames carry a five-year limited warranty against manufacturing defects. Upholstery, mechanisms, and hardware carry a two-year limited warranty. Outdoor cushion covers carry a one-year limited warranty. Coverage begins on delivery to the original purchaser.

# Exclusions

Normal wear, accidental damage, misuse, commercial use, unauthorized repair, and failure to follow care instructions are excluded. Proof of purchase and photographs may be requested. A manager assesses each claim; the assistant cannot promise repair, replacement, or refund.
